name: paper-trading-lab
description: Local paper-trading research lab. Paper trading only; never trades real money.

scripts.postinstall: uv --directory backend sync && npm install --prefix frontend --no-fund --no-audit
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn ptl.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: uv --directory backend run ruff check --no-cache . &&uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . && uv --directory backend run mypy && uv --directory backend run pytest -q
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend
